text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "the applicant concerned is authorised to develop the transmission line project for the specified corridor and initiate the planning approval process", "gist": "Applicant is allowed to develop the transmission line project and start planning approval"}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "Under certain circumstances", "gist": "Only in specific situations"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "it is possible to waive the implementation of a sectoral plan procedure", "gist": "Sectoral plan procedure can be waived"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "SFOE", "gist": "Swiss Federal Office of Energy"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "the SFOE decides on any exemptions from the sectoral plan requirement", "gist": "SFOE is responsible for deciding on exemptions from sectoral plan requirement"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The SFOE determines whether a project concerning a transmission line with a nominal voltage of 220 kV or higher has to be specified in a sectoral plan (verification of a sectoral plan requirement)", "gist": "SFOE verifies if a high-voltage transmission line project needs a sectoral plan"}, {"type": "other", "quote": "This verification is made by the SFOE in its official capacity, or at the request of the Federal Inspectorate for Heavy Current Installations or the applicant", "gist": "Verification can be initiated by SFOE itself, or by the Federal Inspectorate for Heavy Current Installations or the applicant"}]}
